title: Building a certificate program on the fundamentals of the Ministry of Spiritual Liberation and Exorcism
content:
THE signing of the agreement between the Archdiocese of Manila Office of Exorcism - Philippine Association of Catholic Exorcists - Institute Sacerdos San Miguel Arcangel and the PDCIS-IP on the formation of a certificate program on the Fundamentals of the Ministry of Spiritual Liberation and Exorcism was held on Oct. 13, 2026 at the headquarters of the PDCIS-IP.

The program was intended to prepare priests, religious and lay faithful sent by their bishop for the ministry of spiritual liberation and exorcism in their dioceses.

Signatories to the agreement:
